== Japanese printing source review ==
Original Japanese title, lore, game text, subtype, destiny, title marks and icons were read from [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Set-For-Stun-PSA-20261106.jpg|the original photograph]]. Rarity is from the Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 Japanese checklist, p.100. English reading aids were prepared by ChatGPT against this photograph and [[:File:Premiere-D-setforstun.gif|the English printed face]]. The Japanese parenthetical says that the attached cards return to hand without specifying whose hands; the printed English expressly says owners' hands. The Japanese lore refers to the crew rather than the English passengers and omits the English reference to using the stun setting for intimidation. No Credits field is printed.
